Original Decipher card face for [[Tatooine: Desert Landing Site]], rotated losslessly from the archive scan [[:File:Tat-D-tatooinedesertlandingsite-decipher-archive.jpg]] so the location reads landscape.

Source: [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/images/tatooinedesertlandingsiteD.jpg tatooinedesertlandingsiteD.jpg], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021213000742/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/images/tatooinedesertlandingsiteD.jpg Internet Archive], 13 December 2002. SHA-256 of the archived file: 093ca66c6d4fc58ddd68187d0aadb34dd8b89cb47eb25e4dc8fca623ffd55877.

Edits: rotated losslessly from the archive scan (jpegtran -trim -rotate 270 -copy all; JPEG data rotated without recompression). jpegtran drops the partial 8-pixel block at one edge (1 pixel column of black border); no other change.

The Holotable face [[:File:Tat-D-tatooinedesertlandingsite.gif]] is a separate file and is not replaced by this file.

Fair use rationale: this is a low-resolution image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and discuss the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
